chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Walid, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abu al-Mi'za, from 'Anbasah ibn Mus'ab, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Whoever does not visit the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) until he dies, he is deficient in faith and deficient in religion; if he is admitted to Paradise, he will be below the believers in it.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of not visiting Imam Husayn's grave before death?
ai.summary: In the context of Shia devotional practice, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores Ziyarat al-Husayn as a definitive marker of complete faith, linking physical pilgrimage to spiritual perfection. Scholars interpret the phrase 'deficient in faith' not as a loss of belief entirely, but as a lack of the fullness of conviction associated with loving the Ahl al-Bayt, which affects one's hierarchical rank in Paradise even if salvation is secured.
